name: base-server-nodejs
description: REST API server Express.js + Prisma + Neon — deploy Vercel serverless

scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs dev prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs dev prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs prod prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:deploy:staging: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs staging prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:deploy:prod: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs prod prisma migrate deploy
scripts.build: prisma generate && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs prod prisma migrate deploy
